correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 and theta>0, remove a conditioned fixed point to retain Ewens(n-1,theta). Enumerate two prescribed image arrows by completed partial cycles to get q_n. Derive each indexed covariance and w_n with the double-fixed correction, sum and simplify. Every denominator is strictly positive and the cyclic numerator factors as -n theta(n-2)(theta-1)(n+2theta-3). Checks: the standalone standard-library verifier passed 1,252 exact rational comparisons of complete n=3..8 distributions across seven theta values; finite checks do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: For the natural Ewens cycle-bias deformation of uniform permutations, the matrix has exact local support only at theta=1 and gains a position-independent signed nonlocal background otherwise. The circular descent statistic distinguishes bias directions by a universal covariance sign, identifying a mathematically motivated structural boundary not captured by marginal moment computations alone.
